description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - A certificate of exemptions were issued to Fairway Galle (Pvt) Ltd., and Iconic Developments (Pvt) Ltd., under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act
categorisation: This gazette contains a notice from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing certificates of exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. This constitutes regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory matters, specifically involving statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
